फिल्म Gunmaaster G9 का नया गाना 'Dard-E-Dil Dard-E-Jigar' कल यानी 30 October को रिलीज होने जा रहा है। 🎵

इस नए ट्रैक को Himesh Reshammiya और Akasa Singh अपनी आवाज दे रहे हैं।

गाने के बोल Sonia Kapoor Reshammiya ने लिखे हैं और म्यूजिक Himesh Reshammiya ने कंपोज किया है। ✍️

यह गाना 'Afsaana Banaaya Aapne' और 'Do Din Ki Zindagi' के बाद एल्बम में शामिल हो रहा है।

फिल्म Gunmaaster G9 में Emraan Hashmi और Genelia Deshmukh मुख्य भूमिका में नजर आएंगे। 🎬

Aditya Datt के निर्देशन में बनी यह फिल्म 27 November 2026 को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज होगी।

ctx.text:
The makers of Gunmaaster G9 are gearing up to release the film’s next song, ‘ Dard-E-Dil Dard-E-Jigar .’ The track is set to arrive tomorrow and features Himesh Reshammiya and Akasa Singh on vocals, with lyrics penned by Sonia Kapoor Reshammiya. The song announcement comes as the film’s music album continues to take shape. ‘ Dard-E-Dil Dard-E-Jigar’ follows ‘ Afsaana Banaaya Aapne’ and ‘ Do Din Ki Zindagi ,’ adding another track to the album ahead of the film’s theatrical release on November 27, 2026.
Himesh Reshammiya, who is also composing the music for Gunmaaster G9 , has joined Akasa Singh for the upcoming track. The lyrics have been written by Sonia Kapoor Reshammiya.
Gunmaaster G9 is directed by Aditya Datt and produced by Deepak Mukut, Hunar Mukut and Sangeeta Ahir under Soham Rockstar Entertainment. The film is presented by Soham Rockstar Entertainment Pvt. Ltd., with Pen Movies handling its distribution and Phars Films distributing it overseas.
The film stars Emraan Hashmi as Eshwar, an ordinary dairy-farm owner who is pushed to extreme lengths by love. Genelia Deshmukh plays the female lead, marking her first on-screen pairing with Emraan.
Aparshakti Khurana also plays a key role with grey shades and an emotional backstory. The film combines action, romance, drama and music, with the soundtrack forming an important part of its promotional campaign.
Gunmaaster G9 also marks a reunion between Emraan Hashmi, director Aditya Datt and Himesh Reshammiya over two decades after they collaborated on Aashiq Banaya Aapne . The upcoming film is scheduled to release worldwide in cinemas on November 27, 2026.
With ' Dard-E-Dil Dard-E-Jigar' arriving tomorrow, audiences will get another glimpse of the musical world being created for the action-romance.
